October 19, 2026 — a note from the sky, and from the data.

Today: the Moon trine Uranus.

It is not among the configurations that stand out — and none do. Across 52 years, 932 sky configurations were tested against a broad market composite. None beat chance after correction for multiple testing.

That is the point of the whole exercise: to state plainly where classical market astrology does not beat a coin toss. The full study — methods and code — is published in the open.
